ownership.quote: The Gemini API provides a code execution tool that enables the model to generate and run Python code.

stage.note: Gemini API code execution is a feature of the Gemini Developer API, a product of Google LLC, wholly owned by Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL), a public company. No standalone funding history exists for this feature.

revenue.basis: Alphabet Inc. consolidated FY2025 revenue per SEC XBRL company-facts (us-gaap:Revenues), reported in the 10-K filed 2026-02-05. This figure is for all of Alphabet, not the Gemini API code-execution feature specifically.

note: This is a feature of Alphabet/Google, not an independently funded company; ownership, stage, and revenue reflect Alphabet Inc. as a whole (public, NASDAQ: GOOGL). No separate funding round or revenue figure exists for the Gemini API code-execution tool itself; it is billed only as part of Gemini model token usage (no separate compute fee).
